Punjab Politician Seeks Ouster of Rival Over Alleged Paper Leaks

A politician from the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) party in Punjab, India, has demanded the ouster of a rival leader over alleged paper leaks. The opposition leader, Jagdeep Singh Warring, is accused of leaking confidential documents related to the upcoming state assembly elections. The SAD leader claims that these leaks are an attempt to undermine the ruling party's chances. The police have denied any involvement in the leaks, stating that they are investigating the matter. The opposition has rejected the allegations, calling them a 'smokescreen' to divert attention from the government's failures.
